messages:
sophia_hu: Quick ask for the partners group — we need a normalized time-series CSV from our HW partners for cost modeling next quarter. Specifically: daily available capacity by SKU, reserved commit legs (units + start/end), spot/ephemeral supply (daily), avg eviction probability, and any latency premium per region/GPU. Can we get this by EOD Wed? cc @jake_r @maria_ops

jake_r: +1. Also ask them to include billing columns: `price_usd_per_hour`, `billing_currency`, and `burst_uplift_pct` for transient burst usage. We should capture performance factors too (tokens/s or inference_throughput) so we can convert GPU-hours -> token-cost.

maria_ops: Quick clarifying q: do we want hourly or daily granularity for spot/reserved signals? daily is easier for partners but hourly would capture diurnal patterns.

sophia_hu: Daily is fine for the first pass (keeps partner burden low). If a partner can provide hourly, great, but mark it in a `granularity` column. Also please have them include `commit_tier` and `commit_discount_pct` so we can map reserved pricing curves.

jake_r: Draft CSV header we should send them (paste into vendor email):
```
date, region, sku, granularity, capacity_available_units, reserved_units_active, reserved_commit_start, reserved_commit_end, spot_units_estimate, avg_eviction_prob, latency_premium_ms, price_usd_per_hour, billing_currency, commit_tier, commit_discount_pct, burst_uplift_pct, perf_factor_tokens_per_s, notes
```

maria_ops: Also ask for an example reserved->spot conversion policy row (how they reallocate reserved capacity to spot during shortfalls) and whether they offer preempt_grace_window or eviction_notice_ms — that's important for our availability modeling.

sophia_hu: Good call. Can we also get a short description field explaining any SKU-level caveats (thermal throttling windows, multi-tenant burst limits, region-specific network egress charges)? Tag partners to include policy links if available.

jake_r: I'll draft the vendor email and include the header + a tiny sample row. cc @maria_ops for SKU canonicalization mapping.

maria_ops: If partners return CSV, please attach to this thread and include the source contact (name + email) and the last updated timestamp in the CSV metadata row. We'll feed into cost_modeling/ingest pipeline.

sophia_hu: Thanks — sending template now. Will follow up in-thread once I get vendor responses. :thumbsup:
